tasks.subject: [project-rooms] [P2] merge_to_room_main + merge queue + validation + merge entries + room_repo_status
tasks.description: Spec §3.6: rooms-capability tools. merge_to_room_main (act tier, membership-gated): refusals NOT_A_PROJECT_ROOM / UNCOMMITTED_WORK / BEHIND_MAIN (with distance) / SYMLINK_ESCAPES_REPO / FILE_TOO_LARGE / REPO_CAP_EXCEEDED; MERGE_IN_FLIGHT queues on a per-room mutex (bounded FIFO, mergeQueueWaitMs cap); success = server-side git merge --no-ff under the mutex, abort-clean on failure (main never conflicted), then ONE durable unaddressed system-voiced room entry ('X merged Y — N files, +A/−D') that stores no mentions and triggers no turns (cascade-guard assertion), updates lastMergeSeq. room_repo_status (observe): main tip, per-member ahead/behind/dirty, stranded list. No force-push/reset verbs anywhere. Acceptance: every refusal red-before/green-after; concurrent-merge serialization test; the no-cascade test; abort-cleanliness test with an induced conflict.
